items.raw_excerpt: Collapsed WA dairy brands Mundella Foods and the Margaret River Dairy Company have been revived after a deal spearheaded by Harvey Fresh founder Kevin Sorgiovanni.
items.summary_en: Two Western Australian dairy brands, Mundella Foods and Margaret River Dairy Company, were close to closing. A deal led by Harvey Fresh founder Kevin Sorgiovanni brought them back to life. The local brands will keep making cheese and yogurt.

items.raw_excerpt: IIIT-H study reveals AI heatmaps on chest X-rays may misalign with radiologists, urging cautious use of AI in diagnosis.
items.summary_en: Researchers at IIIT Hyderabad studied how AI reads chest X-rays. They found the AI heatmaps often do not match what radiologists see. The team advises doctors to use AI with care in diagnosis.
